examples.arabic: هو جاب لنا هدايا جميلة، وإحنا فرحنا أوي بيها.
examples.english: He brought us beautiful gifts, and we were very happy with them.
examples.transliteration: Howa gab lena hadaya gamila, w e7na fara7na awi beeha.

examples.english: I was very happy with the gifts and laughter.
examples.transliteration: Kont mabsoot awy bel hadaya wel da7k

examples.arabic: بعد كده فتحت الهدايا اللي بابا وماما والعيلة كلها جابوها لها وهي مبسوطة اوي
examples.english: After that, she opened the gifts that Dad and Mom and the whole family brought her, and she was very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ba3d keda fatahet elhadaya elli Baba we Mama wel-3eila kollaha gabouha laha we heya mabsoota awi.

examples.arabic: كل الناس كلت اكل حلو وفرحت بالهدايا الكتير
examples.english: Everyone ate good food and was happy with the many gifts.
examples.transliteration: Koll el nas kalet akl helw w farehet bel hadaya el keteer.

examples.arabic: صاحبي كان مبسوط اوي لما شاف الهدايا
examples.english: My friend was very happy when he saw the gifts.
examples.transliteration: Ṣāḥbī kān mabsūṭ ʾawī lamma shāf el-hadāya.
